mapper.select: select PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.CDATE cdate, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.FINPROD_ID finprodId, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.CCY ccy, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.SHARE_AMT shareAmt, IFNULL(PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.MARKET_VALUE,0)+IFNULL(PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.TDY_INTINCEXP,0)-IFNULL(T5.dscCostAmt,0) dscCostAmt, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.DSC_CLEAN_PRICE dscCleanPrice, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.BUY_COST_AMT buyCostAmt, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.BUY_CLEAN_PRICE buyCleanPrice, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.MARKET_VALUE,0 marketValue, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.MARKET_CLEAN_PRICE marketCleanPrice, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.TDY_INTINCEXP,0 tdyIntincexp, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.TDY_DSCINCEXP_ADD tdy_dscincexpAdd, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.TDY_INTINCEXP_ADD tdyIntincexpAdd, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.TDY_DSCLOSS_ADD tdy_dsclossAdd, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.TDY_FLOAT_INGPL_ADD tdyFloatIngplAdd, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.TDY_FEE_ADD tdyFeeAdd, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.ACCU_NET_VALUE accuNetValue, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.SUB_CODE subCode, PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.ZGPLAN_ID zgplanId, case when T2.Type_8 in ('${fzq}','${fck}','${gp}') then T1.ISSUER when T2.Type_8 = '${fxml}' then T1.FINANCIER else T1.MANAGER end organId, case when T2.Type_8 in ('${gp}','${zqjz}','${whjq}','${whyq}','${whdq}') then T2.TYPE_8 else T2.TYPE_6 end varietyType1, T2.TYPE_7 varietyType2, T2.TYPE_8 assetType from PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION LEFT JOIN ( select SUM(IFNULL(DSC_COST_AMT,0)+IFNULL(TDY_FLOAT_INGPL,0)+IFNULL(TDY_INTINCEXP,0)+ IFNULL(DELAY_PAY_AMT,0)) dscCostAmt, CDATE,PORTFOLIO_ID,FINPROD_ID from PTL_SEC_VALUTION GROUP BY CDATE,PORTFOLIO_ID,FINPROD_ID ) T5 ON T5.FINPROD_ID = PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.FINPROD_ID AND T5.PORTFOLIO_ID = PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.PORTFOLIO_ID AND T5.CDATE = PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.CDATE LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T1 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T2 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T2.FINPROD_ID where PTL_SEC_PIERCE_VALUTION.CDATE = STR_TO_DATE(#{currentDate},'%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT SEQNO seqno, CREDIT_INFO_TYPE creditInfoType, CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_CODE creditQuoteTypeCode, CREDIT_QUOTE_TYPE_VALUE creditQuoteTypeValue, CREDIT_QUOTE_RANK creditQuoteRank FROM CREDIT_MST_INFO where CREDIT_INFO_TYPE = '04'

select SD.INSTITUTION_CODE from MST_CUSTOMER_INFO MCI left join SYS_DEPARTMENT SD on MCI.CREATE_DEPT = SD.DEPT_CODE WHERE 1=1
AND MCI.CUSTOMER_ID = #{customerId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}
